# Research Section Module - FIXED (no duplicate references)
---

```{r}
#| label: research-html-display
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

cat('
## Research Profile

<div class="research-summary">

My research program spans **corporate finance, financial markets, and emerging FinTech applications**. I maintain an active pipeline of high-impact publications while leveraging research to inform curriculum development and student mentoring.

**Current Focus:** Machine learning applications in finance, market microstructure, and corporate financial policy.

<a href="papers.html" class="papers-link"><i class="fas fa-arrow-right"></i> View All Working Papers with Abstracts</a>

</div>

## Publication Metrics

')

pub_metrics <- tribble(
  ~value, ~label, ~context,
  as.character(nrow(publications)), "Total Publications", "Peer-reviewed articles",
  as.character(sum(publications$year >= 2013)), "Recent Output", "Since 2013",
  "500+", "Total Citations", "Google Scholar",
  "12+", "Top-Tier Journals", "JF, RFS, JFE, JCF"
)

cat('<div class="metrics-grid">\n')
for (i in 1:nrow(pub_metrics)) {
  cat(paste0('
<div class="pub-metric">
<span class="metric-value">', pub_metrics$value[i], '</span>
<span class="metric-label">', pub_metrics$label[i], '</span>
<span class="metric-context">', pub_metrics$context[i], '</span>
</div>
'))
}
cat('</div>\n\n')

cat('## Academic Peer Reviewed Articles\n\n')

# Show recent publications
pubs <- publications %>%
  filter(year >= 2013) %>%
  arrange(desc(year), desc(featured))

for (i in 1:min(10, nrow(pubs))) {  # Limit to 10 publications
  citation_text <- if_else(
    !is.na(pubs$volume[i]) && !is.na(pubs$pages[i]),
    paste0(pubs$journal[i], ", ", pubs$volume[i], "(", pubs$issue[i], "), ", pubs$pages[i]),
    pubs$journal[i]
  )
  
  doi_link <- ""
  if (!is.na(pubs$doi[i]) && pubs$doi[i] != "") {
    doi_link <- paste0('<a href="', pubs$doi[i], '" target="_blank"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i></a>')
  }
  
  cat(paste0('
<div class="publication-item">
<div class="pub-year">', pubs$year[i], '</div>
<div class="pub-content">
<div class="pub-title">', pubs$title[i], ' ', doi_link, '</div>
<div class="pub-authors">', pubs$authors[i], '</div>
<div class="pub-venue"><em>', citation_text, '</em></div>
</div>
</div>
'))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: research-pdf-display
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

cat("\\subsection{Academic Peer Reviewed Articles}\n\n")

pubs_pdf <- publications %>%
  filter(year >= 2013) %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  slice(1:min(10, n()))  # Limit to 10 publications

for (i in 1:nrow(pubs_pdf)) {
  cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(pubs_pdf$title[i]), "} (", pubs_pdf$year[i], ")\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(pubs_pdf$authors[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(escape_latex(pubs_pdf$journal[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
}

# Check if pip exists and has data before trying to use it
if (exists("pip") && !is.null(pip) && nrow(pip) > 0) {
  cat("\n\\subsection{Projects in Progress}\n\n")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(pip)) {
    cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(pip$title[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(pip$authors[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
    if (!is.na(pip$status[i])) {
      cat(escape_latex(pip$status[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
}
```
